summary.en: A GRPO-style loop in your process: sample a group per prompt, score it with reward.py, turn the scores into advantages with advantage.py, update. Swap or edit any of the four slots.
summary.zh: 本地进程执行 GRPO 式训练循环：为每个 prompt 采样一组回答，使用 reward.py 评分，再通过 advantage.py 将分数转换为 advantage，最后更新权重。四个插槽均支持替换或编辑。

you_will_see.0.en: Your loop drawn as it runs: which block is executing, on which side of the API, and what it cost
you_will_see.0.zh: 实时展示训练循环的执行状态、API 调用位置及对应费用

you_will_see.1.en: Most of each step on the AWS side: about 24 s to save weights and rebind the sampler, 11 s to sample, 6 s per update (measured 2026-10-29)
you_will_see.1.zh: 每步的大部分时间用于 AWS 操作：保存权重并重新绑定 sampler 约 24 s，采样约 11 s，每次更新约 6 s（2026-10-29 实测）

you_will_see.2.en: A reward check on known answers before the session exists, then reward, groups with signal and sampler-trainer KL per step
you_will_see.2.zh: 创建 session 前，用已知答案校验 reward；训练时逐步查看 reward、有训练信号的组和 sampler–trainer KL

evidence.note.en: In the default reference run, mean reward rose from 0.44 to 0.81 and held-out results from 9/16 to 15/16. Three other default runs scored 9→14, 9→12 and 11→11. Baseline scores also varied; the contribution of sampling noise has not been measured. Reward, advantage, loss and sampler-sync variants have each been run live, but their individual results do not establish a general performance advantage.
evidence.note.zh: 默认设置的参考运行中，平均 reward 从 0.44 升至 0.81，留出集答对数从 9/16 增至 15/16。另外三次默认设置的结果为 9→14、9→12 和 11→11。基座模型得分也有波动，尚未测量采样噪声的影响。Reward、advantage、loss 和 sampler 同步变体均有实时运行记录，但单次结果不足以证明某个变体普遍更优。

node.forward_backward.out.zh: 梯度保存在 GPU 上

slot.reward.exact.summary.en: 1 when the first number is the product, else 0.
slot.reward.exact.summary.zh: 第一个数字等于乘积时得 1，否则得 0。

slot.reward.exact.watch.en: Reward and held-out accuracy rise together.
slot.reward.exact.watch.zh: reward 和留出集准确率一起上升。

slot.reward.partial.summary.en: 1 for the product; a wrong number earns up to 0.5 for digits in the right place.
slot.reward.partial.summary.zh: 答案等于乘积时得 1；答案错误时，根据正确数位的数量最多得 0.5。

slot.reward.partial.watch.en: All-wrong groups are no longer all-equal, so they can give a gradient too. Live (one run) all-wrong groups were rare, and about as many groups gave a gradient as with exact.
slot.reward.partial.watch.zh: 全部答错的组也可能出现分数差异，从而产生梯度。实时运行中（1 次）全部答错的组很少，能产生梯度的组与“完全匹配”相当。

slot.reward.format.summary.en: 1 for any bare number. Cannot tell right from wrong.
slot.reward.format.summary.zh: 纯数字输出得 1 分，不区分答案是否正确。

slot.reward.format.watch.en: The reward check warns. Live, about half the first answers were not bare numbers, so it still trained, toward bare numbers.
slot.reward.format.watch.zh: reward 校验会给出警告。实时运行中，起初约一半回答不是纯数字，因此仍会训练，方向是只输出纯数字。

slot.advantage.group_norm.summary.en: (reward - group mean) / group std, per prompt; all-equal groups are skipped.
slot.advantage.group_norm.summary.zh: 按 prompt 分组计算：(reward − 组均值) / 组标准差；跳过组内得分全部相同的组。

slot.advantage.group_norm.watch.en: Same as the cookbook's grouped advantages.
slot.advantage.group_norm.watch.zh: 与 cookbook 的分组 advantage 相同。

slot.advantage.mean_baseline.summary.en: reward - group mean, per prompt, without dividing by the spread.
slot.advantage.mean_baseline.summary.zh: 按 prompt 分组计算 reward − 组均值，不再按离散程度缩放。

slot.advantage.mean_baseline.watch.en: Same groups train; advantages keep the size of the reward differences.
slot.advantage.mean_baseline.watch.zh: 参与训练的组不变，advantage 会保留 reward 差值的大小。

slot.advantage.batch_norm.summary.en: (reward - batch mean) / batch std: the cookbook's Monte-Carlo + ReB for one turn.
slot.advantage.batch_norm.summary.zh: (reward − batch 均值) / batch 标准差：cookbook 里单轮情况下的 Monte-Carlo + ReB。

slot.advantage.batch_norm.watch.en: All-equal groups train too: more train tokens and cost per step.
slot.advantage.batch_norm.watch.zh: 组内得分全部相同的组也会参与训练，因此每步的 train token 用量和费用会增加。

slot.loss_fn.importance_sampling.summary.en: Policy gradient corrected by the trainer/sampler probability ratio.
slot.loss_fn.importance_sampling.summary.zh: 使用 trainer 与 sampler 的概率比，校正策略梯度。

slot.loss_fn.importance_sampling.watch.en: Returns the rollout_corr/* metrics, so the sampler-trainer KL is charted.
slot.loss_fn.importance_sampling.watch.zh: 返回 rollout_corr/* 指标，可据此绘制 sampler–trainer KL 曲线。

slot.loss_fn.ppo.summary.en: The same ratio, clipped. A policy loss only; there is no critic.
slot.loss_fn.ppo.summary.zh: 对同一概率比进行截断。仅包含策略 loss，不使用 critic。

slot.loss_fn.ppo.watch.en: No rollout_corr/* metrics were published for ppo, so the KL chart stays empty.
slot.loss_fn.ppo.watch.zh: ppo 未发布 rollout_corr/* 指标，因此 KL 图表没有数据。

slot.loss_fn.cispo.summary.en: Clips the importance weight instead of the update.
slot.loss_fn.cispo.summary.zh: 截断的是重要性权重，而不是更新量。

slot.loss_fn.cispo.watch.en: The cookbook's multi-turn code RL used it. No KL chart, as with ppo.
slot.loss_fn.cispo.watch.zh: cookbook 的多轮代码 RL 使用此 loss。与 ppo 一样，不提供 KL 图表。

slot.rebind_every.1.summary.en: On-policy: every sample comes from the weights being trained.
slot.rebind_every.1.summary.zh: On-policy：每个样本都来自正在训练的权重。

slot.rebind_every.1.watch.en: About 20 s of each step is the rebind (measured).
slot.rebind_every.1.watch.zh: 实测每步约有 20 s 用于重新绑定 sampler。

slot.rebind_every.2.summary.en: Every other step samples from weights one update old.
slot.rebind_every.2.summary.zh: 每隔一步，采样所用权重会比当前训练权重少一次更新。

slot.rebind_every.2.watch.en: Half the rebinds and MODEL packages; the KL and 'behind' chart show the lag.
slot.rebind_every.2.watch.zh: 重新绑定次数和 MODEL 包数量减半，可通过 KL 和“落后次数”图表观察权重差异。

slot.rebind_every.4.summary.en: Samples can be up to 3 updates behind the trainer.
slot.rebind_every.4.summary.zh: 采样所用权重最多可能落后 trainer 3 次更新。

slot.rebind_every.4.watch.en: Faster steps, more off-policy data for importance_sampling to correct.
slot.rebind_every.4.watch.zh: 每步耗时更短，但需要 importance_sampling 校正的 off-policy 数据更多。

param.group_size.label.zh: 每个 prompt 的采样数

param.save_checkpoint.label.zh: 保存可恢复训练的 checkpoint

param.save_checkpoint.help.zh: 实测 save_state 耗时 53 s。

param.rebind_every.help.en: Steps between save_weights_and_get_sampling_client calls; 1 keeps sampling on-policy.
param.rebind_every.help.zh: 两次 save_weights_and_get_sampling_client 调用之间的步数；设为 1 可保持 on-policy 采样。

param.max_tokens.label.zh: 每个 completion 的最大 token 数

param.max_tokens.help.en: The service minimum is 512; lower values are raised to 512.
param.max_tokens.help.zh: 服务允许的最小值为 512，低于此值时会自动调整为 512。

metric.updates_behind.label.zh: Sampler 落后于 trainer 的更新次数

events.max_tokens is at least 512, the service: max_tokens 至少为 512，即服务允许的最小值；completion 在首个换行处结束。
events.Held-out problems, greedy answers: base: 留出题目上的贪心解码：对比基座模型与训练后模型
events.correct, with commas: 正确答案，含千分位逗号
events.Correct answers score above wrong ones: 正确答案的得分高于错误答案
events.Otherwise RL moves the model away from c: 否则，RL 可能使模型更难生成正确答案，或无法带来改善。
events.Not every case scores the same: 不同测试情况的得分不完全相同
events.A constant reward makes every group all-: reward 恒定时，各组内得分全部相同，advantage 为零，无法产生梯度；消耗 token 也不会产生训练效果。
events.Final weights for sampling or deployment: 最终权重，可用于采样或部署
